themes: Qualities of the servants of Allah
summary_for_children: Al-Furqan means the Criterion between right and wrong. It shows signs in nature like shadows and two seas, and ends by describing the servants of the Most Merciful, who walk humbly and answer harshness with peace.
world_title: Walk of the Servants of the Merciful
environment_concept: A sundial field where shadows move with the sun (25:45), winds driving clouds (25:48), two waters side by side with a barrier (25:53), the sun and the moon (25:61) and a gentle path (25:63).
architecture_and_scenery: Open plains where shadows stretch and shrink, a coast where fresh and salt water meet, a starry sky with a lamp-like sun, and a simple path through gardens.

palette.lighting: Day-long sun cycle making shadows grow and shrink

areas.name: Field of Shadows
areas.description: A sundial field where shadows move with the sun.

areas.name: Winds of Good Tidings
areas.description: Winds pushing clouds that bring pure water.

areas.name: Two Seas and a Barrier
areas.description: Fresh and salt water side by side with a visible barrier.

areas.name: Sky Lamp
areas.description: Great stars, a burning lamp and a luminous moon.

areas.name: Path of Gentle Walking
areas.description: A garden path for humble walking.

primary_mechanic.text: Watch shadows lengthen and shorten over a day and place markers where the shadow will be (25:45-46).

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Path of Good Character
story_library.children_narration: Look at the shadows, the winds, the water, and the changing day. The Quran invites us to recognize signs of creation. It also describes the servants of the Most Merciful as humble people who avoid harmful behavior and respond thoughtfully when others treat them badly.

world_idea.title: The Shadow and Sun Observatory
world_idea.description: Explore changes in daylight and shadows, then practice kind responses in an interactive communication challenge.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
